device.model: HD X4 220 (System ID 06020200, ILTV HD Edision 1.5.27 build)
device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with CA card reader / CI variants (HD X402p / X403p / X4 family)
device.board: 06020200 (Globo / Opticum M3602B "220" platform with Lemontree EuP front-panel MCU)
device.soc: ALi M3602B (bootloader "M3602B 1.1.6"; NIM_S3501_0, NIM_COFDM_0, DMX_S3601_0, DECV_AVC_0, DECV_S3601_0, OSD_S36_0/1, VPO_S3601)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB1 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.author: Globo / ILTV HD (gisclub.tv Edision GUI mod)
source.note: Archive globo_x4_iltvHD_edision_1.5.27_gisclub.tv.rar from the Opticum / Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 directory on satedu.cba.pl.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_globo_x4_iltv_1527_app_starts.py, run_dump_globo_x4_iltv_1527_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 4-digit 7-segment display " ON " -> "    " -> "boot"), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) (7.19 MB) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and renders its ILTV HD Edision OSD dialog through GeM3602 (7 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: Globo / Opticum HD X4 220 (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.5.27 with the ILTV HD Edision GUI (2012-03-18) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
